form.permissions: Clicking “Run” or “Submit Assessment” runs a snapshot of your current code locally. Each case runs in a temporary directory without project files. This is not a sandbox: code has the service account’s permissions. The total limit is 30 seconds and 256 KiB of output. No environments are installed automatically, and cancellation does not roll back changes.

pending.summary: Preparing to run the code in this submission.

running.summary: Checking your code. Results will appear when the checks finish.

stopped.summary: This run stopped before the code checks were complete.
stopped.nextStep: Run again or submit the Assessment when you’re ready. Stopping does not undo actions the program has already taken, and will not automatically rerun it.

unavailable.summary: This computer is missing the environment needed to run this code, so it cannot yet be checked against the requirements.
unavailable.nextStep: Check that the required tools are installed and available on the command line, then run again. The system will not install them automatically.

timed-out.summary: The program exceeded the time limit before the code checks were complete.
timed-out.nextStep: Check for loops or waits that never finish, then run again.

output-limit.summary: The program produced too much output and checking was stopped.
output-limit.nextStep: Check for unnecessary repeated printing, revise your code, then run again.

failed.summary: The program encountered an error before the run checks for this question were complete.
failed.nextStep: Open the run details to locate the error. After fixing it, try a run before submitting the Assessment.

incomplete.summary: This run did not complete, so the code cannot yet be checked against the requirements.
incomplete.nextStep: Open the run details to investigate, resolve the issue, then run again.

mismatched.summary_one: Output from {{count}} check did not match the question’s requirements.
mismatched.summary_other: Output from {{count}} checks did not match the question’s requirements.
mismatched.nextStep: Compare the inputs, required output, and actual output below. Revise your code, confirm with a trial run, then submit the Assessment again.

matched.summary_one: Your code passed this question’s {{count}} run check. This only means the listed input produced the expected output.
matched.summary_other: Your code passed this question’s {{count}} run checks. This only means the listed inputs produced the expected output.
